items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was the best PR man I ever had.

ctx.x: Did doors open up for you then?
Yes. He was the best PR man I ever had.
This antipathy, as I think you described it, between musicians and vocalists – I’m sure that existed then. How were you tested? I’m sure everyone didn’t just take Bird’s word for it.
